child_list.content: The fox and the tiger
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content: One day, a tiger saw a fox taking a walk. The tiger was very happy. He caught the fox. The fox shouted loudly, “Wait! I’m the new king of beasts. You can’t eat me.” The tiger didn’t believe the fox. The fox said, “You can come after me. All the animals will be afraid of me.” The tiger followed the fox. The animals saw them and ran away. Then the tiger believed the fox and let him go. In fact, the poor tiger didn’t know that those animals were scared of himself.

child_list.content: Hello, hello, hello

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

It’s wonderful night, let’s dance in the moonlight

child_list.content: 狐假虎威
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 一天，一只老虎看见一只狐狸在散步。老虎很高兴。他抓住了那只狐狸。狐狸大声喊道：“等等！我是新的百兽之王。 你不能吃我。”老虎不相信狐狸的话。狐狸说：“你可以跟我来。所有的动物都会怕我。”老虎跟着狐狸。动物们看见他们就跑开了。老虎相信了狐狸的话，放了他。事实上，这只可怜的老虎并不知道那些动物怕的是他自己。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
